from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financing cash flow data extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as appearing in the document")
    financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="筹资活动产生的现金流量净额 as a numeric value")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_table: str | None = Field(description="The financial table where this data appears, e.g., '合并现金流量表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: list[CompanyFinanceRecord]
